0x10288FF0.name: SqmdDMB_BuildUpdaters
0x10288FF0.evidence: Its trace prints the DLL string "%06ld ... sqmdDMBBuildUpdaters ..." (0x103B9420) on entry; it then clears the globals 0x109A2758..0x109A276C and walks the model's items of kind 2, testing names against "untitled" and the "_sort" suffix.
0x10288FF0.summary: sqmdDMBBuildUpdaters: builds the updater list of a model into the DMB being built.
